ingredients.name: peanut oil
ingredients.source: FDC 171410 (Oil, peanut, salad or cooking). Oil pressed from peanuts (groundnut, arachis), listed so a peanut rule covers it: refined, roasted or cold-pressed, the graph treats it as containing peanut, since a label can't be verified from here.

ingredients.name: split moong dal
ingredients.source: FDC 174256 is whole mung beans; split, dehulled dal has somewhat less fiber.

ingredients.name: green chilli
ingredients.source: Nutrients: FDC 170497. gramsPerUnit 5 g: editor estimate for a slender Indian green chilli (FDC portion of 45 g is for a large pepper).

ingredients.name: grated coconut
ingredients.source: FDC 170169. Shop-bought desiccated coconut is often preserved with sulphites, so it counts as sulphites for checking (unsafeFor).

ingredients.name: mustard seed
ingredients.source: FDC 170929 is ground mustard seed, used for whole seed; its density (2 g/tsp) is for ground, whole seed is likely denser.

ingredients.name: shallot
ingredients.source: Nutrients: FDC 170499. gramsPerUnit 10 g: editor estimate for a small Kerala shallot (no FDC per-unit portion).

ingredients.name: curry leaf
ingredients.source: India NIN, Nutritive Value of Indian Foods (Gopalan et al.), curry leaves; carb is by difference (available carb + fiber). Sugars and sodium not reported, set to 0. No FDC record.

ingredients.name: curry leaf sprig
ingredients.source: India NIN, Nutritive Value of Indian Foods (Gopalan et al.), curry leaves; carb is by difference (available carb + fiber). Sugars and sodium not reported, set to 0. No FDC record. gramsPerUnit 2 g: editor estimate for one sprig.

ingredients.name: ghee

ingredients.name: pappadam

ingredients.name: gelatine
ingredients.source: FDC 169599 (gelatins, dry powder, unsweetened); density from its 1 envelope (1 tbsp) = 7 g portion. Made from pork, beef or fish collagen and the label rarely says which, so it counts as meat, pork and fish for checking (unsafeFor). EU law permits sulphites in gelatine, so it also counts as sulphites.

ingredients.name: fresh herbs
ingredients.source: A category for fresh leafy herbs (coriander, parsley, mint, basil, curry leaves, epazote and the like), listed for Pantry Frames and keep times. No FDC record for the category, so no nutrition values. Label-dependent: a line that says only "herbs" could be any herb (celery leaf, chives, lovage), so it is never verified under a restricting rule. Broad: too broad to be a rule target; a rule naming it gets an ask for which herb.
